digest.component_or_area: plan-review T10 overlay rubric and evaluation spec
propositions: The T10 rubric must partition routine durable-infrastructure (IaC/config) checks from transient throwaway de-risk experiments while preserving all four existing MAJOR safety classes (destructive apply, wildcard-admin, plaintext-secret, untrusted-network endpoint-auth).
The exact scope clause and four-MAJOR-class safety qualifier must appear adjacent in the T10 rubric text and must be rendered by rebar explain and the regenerated criteria guide.

The packaged plan-review-T10 eval spec must contain ten balanced dataset cases (five pass, five finding) covering transient private-probe isolation, durable-lifecycle safety, destructive transient applies, transient wildcard-admin, transient plaintext-secrets, and untrusted-network transient services.
The T10 rubric must not reference T15 or assign scope to any other overlay; independence must be enforced by offline text-contract tests.

The strict packaged-spec registration (NEW_SPECS in test_new_eval_specs.py) must validate plan-review-T10 schema, scorer discipline, dataset balance, and non-empty gold data without cross-criterion delegation.

Live criterion evaluation must report pass for five benign cases (scoped teardown, fully specified durable, private-network transient, secret-manager transient, sandboxed teardown) and finding for five unsafe cases (under-specified durable-lifecycle, destructive transient, transient wildcard-admin, transient plaintext-secret, untrusted-network transient service) with full stability and recall across three runs.
